dashboard.label: Better Map - Threat Map
dashboard.description: NORSE-style live threat map: glowing great-circle arcs between attack origins and three target hubs (Washington DC, London, Tokyo), pulsing target markers, cyber palette, 3D cinematic camera, vignette. Top-row KPIs (attacks/min, blocked %, critical count, unique sources, top severity), severity + action filter dropdowns, top-source / top-target / top-attack-type tables, attacks/min sparkline. Replace the inline SPL with your firewall, IDS, or threat-intel feed to go live.
